method: Literal expectations independently written from original tweaker and CoreKey loop operands, with the four native target indicator tail defaults supplied by the separate catalogue observation. No production converter generates these expected strings.
preservation_obligations: The target agent has BistableSwitchBlock and GroupAssertOnPowerup but classic source agents do not; preserve target baseline rather than invent source values.
RetardationIndex is a PP-only field in this conversion graph and retains its target baseline.
NightlightColour is not a CouplerPro constructor attribute.
Source PP may lack IndicatorBrightness and InfraRedBank even though their source agent attributes exist; final coupler brightness is immutable and IRBank has no same-named source.
Unknown PP fields, preserved metadata and native trailing indicator entries remain unchanged.
No-op checks must compare the native normalized target arrays, including preserved tail values, rather than raw tweaker prefix strings alone.
BCI4A uses its original TBCI4A model registration with the separately evidenced BCN4B.xml specification alias.
required_refusals_before_io: source firmware other than 1.2.67 or target firmware other than 2.2.00
an unregistered pair among the six unit names
a reused or prehydrated target model supplied as the fresh-target lifecycle
a specification alias other than the exact native BCI4A to BCN4B.xml case
missing, short, long, malformed or out-of-range GroupAddress/IndicatorFunction source arrays
unproved PP schema or metadata shape
